## Bayesian Models

```{r}
### Bayesian track-level model of movement

## set factor levels
month_levels <- if (is.factor(track_centers_env$month)) {
  levels(track_centers_env$month)
} else {
  unique(as.character(track_centers_env$month))
}

year_levels <- sort(unique(c(
  as.character(track_centers_env$year),
  as.character(gps_env$year)
)))


## Track-level Gaussian models

track_bayes <- track_centers_env %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(center_y),
    !is.na(center_x),
    !is.na(month),
    !is.na(year),
    !is.na(tide_height_m),
    !is.na(moon_illumination)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    month = factor(as.character(month), levels = month_levels),
    year  = factor(as.character(year), levels = year_levels),
    month_id = as.integer(month),
    year_id  = as.integer(year),
    tide_s = as.numeric(scale(tide_height_m)),
    moon_s = as.numeric(scale(moon_illumination)),
    center_y_s = as.numeric(scale(center_y)),
    center_x_s = as.numeric(scale(center_x))
  )

d_track_y_scaled <- list(
  N = nrow(track_bayes),
  Y = track_bayes$center_y_s,
  month = track_bayes$month_id,
  tide = track_bayes$tide_s,
  moon = track_bayes$moon_s,
  year = track_bayes$year_id,
  n_month = nlevels(track_bayes$month),
  n_year = nlevels(track_bayes$year)
)

d_track_x_scaled <- list(
  N = nrow(track_bayes),
  Y = track_bayes$center_x_s,
  month = track_bayes$month_id,
  tide = track_bayes$tide_s,
  moon = track_bayes$moon_s,
  year = track_bayes$year_id,
  n_month = nlevels(track_bayes$month),
  n_year = nlevels(track_bayes$year)
)

m_track_y <- ulam(
  alist(
    Y ~ dnorm(mu, sigma),
    mu <- a + a_month[month] + b_tide * tide + b_moon * moon + a_year[year],

    a ~ dnorm(0, 1),
    a_month[month] ~ dnorm(0, sigma_month),
    a_year[year] ~ dnorm(0, sigma_year),

    b_tide ~ dnorm(0, 1),
    b_moon ~ dnorm(0, 1),

    sigma ~ dexp(1),
    sigma_month ~ dexp(1),
    sigma_year ~ dexp(1)
  ),
  data = d_track_y_scaled,
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 2000
)

m_track_x <- ulam(
  alist(
    Y ~ dnorm(mu, sigma),
    mu <- a + a_month[month] + b_tide * tide + b_moon * moon + a_year[year],

    a ~ dnorm(0, 1),
    a_month[month] ~ dnorm(0, sigma_month),
    a_year[year] ~ dnorm(0, sigma_year),

    b_tide ~ dnorm(0, 1),
    b_moon ~ dnorm(0, 1),

    sigma ~ dexp(1),
    sigma_month ~ dexp(1),
    sigma_year ~ dexp(1)
  ),
  data = d_track_x_scaled,
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 2000
)
```

```{r}
### 2-second GPS cell-based model

cell_size <- 25

gps_use <- gps_env %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(file_name),
    !is.na(x_true_m),
    !is.na(y_true_m),
    !is.na(month),
    !is.na(year),
    !is.na(tide_height_m),
    !is.na(moon_illumination)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    month = factor(as.character(month), levels = month_levels),
    year  = factor(as.character(year), levels = year_levels),
    x_cell = floor(x_true_m / cell_size),
    y_cell = floor(y_true_m / cell_size)
  )

# Track effort = total number of 2-sec fixes in each track
track_effort <- gps_use %>%
  count(file_name, name = "n_fixes_track") %>%
  mutate(log_effort = log(n_fixes_track))

# Aggregate number of 2-sec fixes per track x cell
gps_cells <- gps_use %>%
  group_by(
    file_name, year, month,
    tide_height_m, moon_illumination,
    x_cell, y_cell
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_fixes_cell = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(track_effort, by = "file_name") %>%
  mutate(
    seconds_in_cell = n_fixes_cell * 2,
    cell_id  = as.integer(factor(paste(x_cell, y_cell, sep = "_"))),
    track_id = as.integer(factor(file_name)),
    month_id = as.integer(month),
    year_id  = as.integer(year),
    tide_s = as.numeric(scale(tide_height_m)),
    moon_s = as.numeric(scale(moon_illumination))
  )

d_cells_nb <- list(
  N = nrow(gps_cells),
  count = gps_cells$n_fixes_cell,
  month = gps_cells$month_id,
  year = gps_cells$year_id,
  track = gps_cells$track_id,
  cell = gps_cells$cell_id,
  tide = gps_cells$tide_s,
  moon = gps_cells$moon_s,
  log_effort = gps_cells$log_effort,
  n_month = nlevels(gps_use$month),
  n_year = nlevels(gps_use$year),
  n_track = length(unique(gps_cells$track_id)),
  n_cell = length(unique(gps_cells$cell_id))
)

# Negative binomial (gamma-Poisson) with effort offset and cell effect
m_space_use <- ulam(
  alist(
    count ~ dgampois(lambda, phi),
    log(lambda) <- log_effort +
      a +
      a_month[month] +
      a_year[year] +
      a_track[track] +
      a_cell[cell] +
      b_tide * tide +
      b_moon * moon,

    a ~ dnorm(0, 1),

    a_month[month] ~ dnorm(0, sigma_month),
    a_year[year] ~ dnorm(0, sigma_year),
    a_track[track] ~ dnorm(0, sigma_track),
    a_cell[cell] ~ dnorm(0, sigma_cell),

    b_tide ~ dnorm(0, 1),
    b_moon ~ dnorm(0, 1),

    sigma_month ~ dexp(1),
    sigma_year ~ dexp(1),
    sigma_track ~ dexp(1),
    sigma_cell ~ dexp(1),

    phi ~ dexp(1)
  ),
  data = d_cells_nb,
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 2000
)

```

```{r}
#### Diagnostics and posterior summaries for track-level models
#| cache: true

## posterior summaries
precis(m_track_y, depth = 2)
precis(m_track_x, depth = 2)

plot(precis(m_track_y, depth = 2))
plot(precis(m_track_x, depth = 2))

## trace/rank plots
# Track Y
par(mfrow = c(2,2))
trankplot(m_track_y, ask = FALSE)
par(mfrow = c(1,1))

# Track X
par(mfrow = c(2,2))
trankplot(m_track_x, ask = FALSE)
par(mfrow = c(1,1))


## convergence check
summary(m_track_y)
summary(m_track_x)

## posterior predictive check
y_sim <- sim(m_track_y, n = 1000)

dens(d_track_y_scaled$Y)
for(i in 1:50) dens(y_sim[i,], add = TRUE, col = col.alpha("blue", 0.1))
title("Posterior predictive check: m_track_y")


x_sim <- sim(m_track_x, n = 1000)

dens(d_track_x_scaled$Y)
for(i in 1:50) dens(x_sim[i,], add = TRUE, col = col.alpha("blue", 0.1))
title("Posterior predictive check: m_track_x")


#### Diagnostics and posterior summaries for space-use model

## posterior summaries
precis(m_space_use, depth = 2)
plot(precis(m_space_use, depth = 2))

par(mfrow = c(2,2))
trankplot(m_space_use, ask = FALSE)
par(mfrow = c(1,1))

## convergence check
summary(m_space_use)

## posterior predictive check
x_sim <- sim(m_space_use, n = 1000)

hist(d_cells_nb$count, breaks = 30, col = "grey",
     main = "Observed vs simulated counts")
for(i in 1:50) {
  hist(x_sim[i,], breaks = 30,
       col = col.alpha("blue", 0.1), add = TRUE)
}

mean_sim <- apply(x_sim, 1, mean)
dens(mean_sim, col = "blue")
abline(v = mean(d_cells_nb$count), lwd = 2)
title("Mean check")

var_sim <- apply(x_sim, 1, var)
dens(var_sim, col = "blue")
abline(v = var(d_cells_nb$count), lwd = 2)
title("Variance check")

zero_sim <- apply(x_sim, 1, function(x) sum(x == 0))
dens(zero_sim, col = "blue")
abline(v = sum(d_cells_nb$count == 0), lwd = 2)
title("Zero count check")

max_sim <- apply(x_sim, 1, max)
dens(max_sim, col = "blue")
abline(v = max(d_cells_nb$count), lwd = 2)
title("Maximum count check")

```

```{r}
### Extreme hotspot

# Extract posterior samples
post <- extract.samples(m_space_use)

# compute mean cell effect
cell_effect <- apply(post$a_cell, 2, mean)
cell_low    <- apply(post$a_cell, 2, PI, prob = 0.89)[1, ]
cell_high   <- apply(post$a_cell, 2, PI, prob = 0.89)[2, ]

# attach back to your spatial data
cell_map <- gps_cells %>%
  distinct(cell_id, x_cell, y_cell) %>%
  arrange(cell_id) %>%
  mutate(
    effect = cell_effect,
    low    = cell_low,
    high   = cell_high
  )

cell_map <- cell_map %>%
  mutate(
    intensity = exp(effect)
  )

library(ggplot2)

threshold <- quantile(cell_map$intensity, 0.9)

cell_map <- cell_map %>%
  mutate(
    hotspot = intensity > threshold
  )

ggplot(cell_map, aes(x = x_cell, y = y_cell)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = intensity)) +
  geom_point(data = subset(cell_map, hotspot),
             color = "red", size = 2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "turbo") +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
### Consecutive points in the same cell

# create bouts
library(dplyr)

cell_size <- 50

gps_bouts <- gps_env %>%
  arrange(file_name, datetime_local) %>%   # IMPORTANT: time order
  mutate(
    x_cell = floor(x_true_m / cell_size),
    y_cell = floor(y_true_m / cell_size),
    cell_id = paste(x_cell, y_cell, sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  group_by(file_name) %>%
  mutate(
    new_bout = cell_id != lag(cell_id, default = first(cell_id)),
    bout_id = cumsum(new_bout)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

#calculate bout duration
bouts_summary <- gps_bouts %>%
  group_by(file_name, cell_id, bout_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_points = n(),
    duration_sec = n_points * 2,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# summarise per track-cell
cell_behavior <- bouts_summary %>%
  group_by(file_name, cell_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_visits = n(),                         # number of bouts
    total_time = sum(duration_sec),         # total time in cell
    mean_duration = mean(duration_sec),     # average stay
    max_duration = max(duration_sec),       # longest stay
    .groups = "drop"
  )

View(cell_behavior)
```

```{r}
### Classify behavior per cell

cell_behavior <- cell_behavior %>%
  mutate(
    high_time = total_time > median(total_time),
    high_visit = n_visits > median(n_visits),

    behavior = case_when(
      high_time & high_visit ~ "Core area",
      high_time & !high_visit ~ "Long stay",
      !high_time & high_visit ~ "Revisited",
      TRUE ~ "Transit"
    )
  )

ggplot(cell_behavior, aes(x = x_cell, y = y_cell, fill = behavior)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", size = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Core area" = "red",
    "Long stay" = "orange",
    "Revisited" = "blue",
    "Transit" = "grey80"
  )) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Behavioral use of space")
```

```{r}
### Bout duration Gaussian model 

# First extract one row per bout with environmental data
bout_covariates <- gps_bouts %>%
  group_by(file_name, bout_id) %>%
  summarise(
    tide_height_m = first(tide_height_m),
    moon_illumination = first(moon_illumination),
    month = first(month),
    year = first(year),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Join with bout durations
bout_data <- bouts_summary %>%
  left_join(bout_covariates, by = c("file_name", "bout_id"))

# prepare variables
bout_data <- bout_data %>%
  filter(duration_sec > 0) %>%   # just in case
  mutate(
    log_duration = log(duration_sec),

    # IDs for hierarchical effects
    month_id = as.integer(factor(month)),
    year_id = as.integer(factor(year)),
    track_id = as.integer(factor(file_name)),

    # standardize predictors
    tide_s = as.numeric(scale(tide_height_m)),
    moon_s = as.numeric(scale(moon_illumination))
  )

# build data luist for ulam
d_bout <- list(
  N = nrow(bout_data),
  Y = bout_data$log_duration,
  tide = bout_data$tide_s,
  moon = bout_data$moon_s,
  month = bout_data$month_id,
  year = bout_data$year_id,
  track = bout_data$track_id,

  n_month = length(unique(bout_data$month_id)),
  n_year = length(unique(bout_data$year_id)),
  n_track = length(unique(bout_data$track_id))
)

# Full bout model
library(rethinking)

m_bout <- ulam(
  alist(
    Y ~ dnorm(mu, sigma),

    mu <- a +
          a_month[month] +
          a_year[year] +
          a_track[track] +
          b_tide * tide +
          b_moon * moon,

    # priors
    a ~ dnorm(0, 1),

    a_month[month] ~ dnorm(0, sigma_month),
    a_year[year] ~ dnorm(0, sigma_year),
    a_track[track] ~ dnorm(0, sigma_track),

    b_tide ~ dnorm(0, 1),
    b_moon ~ dnorm(0, 1),

    sigma ~ dexp(1),
    sigma_month ~ dexp(1),
    sigma_year ~ dexp(1),
    sigma_track ~ dexp(1)
  ),
  data = d_bout,
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  iter = 2000
)

# predicted effect of tide
tide_seq_m <- seq(min(bout_data$tide_height_m),
                  max(bout_data$tide_height_m),
                  length.out = 100)

tide_seq_s <- (tide_seq_m - mean(bout_data$tide_height_m)) /
              sd(bout_data$tide_height_m)

pred_data <- list(
  tide = tide_seq_s,
  moon = rep(0, length(tide_seq_s)),
  month = rep(1, length(tide_seq_s)),
  year = rep(1, length(tide_seq_s)),
  track = rep(1, length(tide_seq_s))
)

mu <- link(m_bout, data = pred_data)

mu_mean <- apply(mu, 2, function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))

mu_PI <- apply(mu, 2, function(x)
  quantile(x, probs = c(0.055, 0.945), na.rm = TRUE)
)

pred_df <- data.frame(
  tide_m = tide_seq_m,                  
  duration = exp(mu_mean),
  low = exp(mu_PI[1, ]),
  high = exp(mu_PI[2, ])
)

ggplot(bout_data, aes(x = tide_height_m, y = duration_sec)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_line(data = pred_df,
            aes(x = tide_m, y = duration),
            color = "red", size = 1.2) +
  geom_ribbon(data = pred_df,
              aes(x = tide_m, ymin = low, ymax = high),
              alpha = 0.2,
              inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    x = "Tide height (m)",
    y = "Bout duration (seconds)",
    title = "Effect of tide on shark residence time"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


precis(m_bout, depth = 2)

precis(m_bout, pars = c("b_tide", "b_moon"))

y_sim <- sim(m_bout, n = 1000)

dens(d_bout$Y)
for(i in 1:50) dens(y_sim[i,], add = TRUE, col = col.alpha("blue", 0.1))

post <- extract.samples(m_bout)

mean(exp(post$b_tide))
mean(exp(post$b_moon))
```

```{r}
## Probability of long-stay vs transit

# response variable (bout level)
threshold <- quantile(bout_data$duration_sec, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)

bout_data <- bout_data %>%
  mutate(
    long_stay = ifelse(duration_sec >= threshold, 1, 0)
  )

# build data
d_longstay <- list(
  N = nrow(bout_data),
  Y = bout_data$long_stay,

  tide = bout_data$tide_s,
  moon = bout_data$moon_s,
  month = bout_data$month_id,
  year = bout_data$year_id,
  track = bout_data$track_id,

  n_month = length(unique(bout_data$month_id)),
  n_year = length(unique(bout_data$year_id)),
  n_track = length(unique(bout_data$track_id))
)

d_longstay <- list(
  N = nrow(bout_data),
  Y = bout_data$long_stay,

  tide = bout_data$tide_s,
  moon = bout_data$moon_s,
  month = bout_data$month_id,
  year = bout_data$year_id,
  track = bout_data$track_id,

  n_month = length(unique(bout_data$month_id)),
  n_year = length(unique(bout_data$year_id)),
  n_track = length(unique(bout_data$track_id))
)

# Bayesian logistic model
library(rethinking)

m_longstay <- ulam(
  alist(
    Y ~ dbern(p),

    logit(p) <- a +
                a_year[year] +
                a_track[track] +
                b_tide * tide +
                b_moon * moon,

    a ~ dnorm(0, 1),

    a_year[year] ~ dnorm(0, sigma_year),
    a_track[track] ~ dnorm(0, sigma_track),

    b_tide ~ dnorm(0, 1),
    b_moon ~ dnorm(0, 1),

    sigma_year ~ dexp(1),
    sigma_track ~ dexp(1)
  ),
  data = d_longstay,
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95)
)

precis(m_longstay, pars = c("b_tide", "b_moon"))

# convert to odds ratios
post <- extract.samples(m_longstay)

mean(exp(post$b_tide))
mean(exp(post$b_moon))

```
